select host(s.ip) as ip
from (
  select ip,
         min(case when source in ('feodo', 'dshield') then 0 else 1 end) as prio,
         max(last_ingested_at) as recent
  from ip_sightings
  where seen_on >= current_date - 7
  group by ip
) s
left join enrichment e on e.ip = s.ip and e.provider = 'ipapi'
where e.ip is null or e.expires_at < now()
order by s.prio, s.recent desc
limit 100

with up as (
  insert into enrichment (ip, provider, status, data, expires_at)
  select distinct on (r.ip, r.provider) r.ip::inet, r.provider, r.status, coalesce(r.data, '{}'),
         now() + make_interval(days => r.ttl_days)
  from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as r(ip text, provider text, status text, data jsonb, ttl_days int)
  on conflict (ip, provider)
  do update set status = excluded.status, data = excluded.data, fetched_at = now(),
                expires_at = excluded.expires_at
  returning status
)
select status, count(*) as saved from up group by status

## Threat map: enrich IPs

Looks up IPs from `ip_sightings` that have no fresh row in `enrichment`. C2 (Feodo) and DShield IPs go first.

| Provider | Gives | Per run | Cache |
|---|---|---|---|
| ip-api.com batch | geo, ASN, hosting flag | 100 / 5 min | 30 d |
| Shodan InternetDB | open ports, CPEs, CVEs, tags | 30 / 5 min, 1/s | 7 d |
| GreyNoise community | scanner vs targeted, malicious/benign | **1 / hour** | 7 d |
| AbuseIPDB check | abuse score, report count, usage type, Tor flag | 3 / 5 min (864 of 1000/day) | 7 d |
| AlienVault OTX | pulse count, pulse names/tags, reputation | 30 / 5 min, 2/s | 7 d |

GreyNoise without a key allows **25 lookups a day**, hence hourly. Add a key (header `key`) to raise it. A 429 or 5xx is not cached, so the IP is retried later.
